name: Sendspin
description: The `sendspin` component adds support for [Sendspin](https://www.sendspin-audio.com), a multi-room synchronized audio protocol. The hub manages the connection to a Sendspin server and distributes state updates to any Sendspin child components.

config_entries.label: Model
config_entries.description: The model the device reports to the Sendspin server. Defaults to the project part of the [project name](https://esphome.io/components/esphome#esphome-creators_project) when one is set, otherwise the device's name.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the artwork slot. Use this to target the action below.

config_entries.label: Firmware Version
config_entries.description: The firmware version the device reports to the Sendspin server. Defaults to the [project version](https://esphome.io/components/esphome#esphome-creators_project) when one is set, otherwise the ESPHome version.

config_entries.label: Manufacturer
config_entries.description: The manufacturer the device reports to the Sendspin server. Defaults to the author part of the [project name](https://esphome.io/components/esphome#esphome-creators_project) when one is set, otherwise `ESPHome`.

config_entries.label: Task Stack In PSRAM
config_entries.description: If `true`, the FreeRTOS playback task stack is allocated in PSRAM instead of internal RAM. Requires the [psram](https://esphome.io/components/psram/) component. Defaults to `false`.
